ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Apr-22-2014 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled this day for OSC hearing for Name Change.
Dept. 514, Judge: Harry M. Dorfman, Clerk: Yolanda Mazariegos, CSR: Mitch Lyon, #6840
PetitionerBrenda Paola Marzal Barriga mother of minor present in court.
Petitioner sworn and examined.
Proof of Publication on file.
Order Granting Request to Change Name of minor without conset of other parent on file.
No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct and sufficient, and that the petition should be granted.
The court grants the petition for Change of Name of minor from Breyner Ayton Marzal Barriga to Ayton Marzal.
Court also grants petition for Change of Name of Brenda Paola Marzal Barriga to Brenda Paola Marzal.
Decree Changing Names signed in open court.

ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-06-2014 Reset To Apr-22-14 At 09:00 A.M. In Dept 514 For Order To Show Cause
